acquisition method: The top twenty most intense signals in the acquired MS spectra were selected for further MS/MS analysis.
alkylation reagent: add 100 μL of iodoacetamide buffer (100 mM iodoacetamide in UA)
alkylation concentration: add 100 μL of iodoacetamide buffer (100 mM iodoacetamide in UA)
cleavage agent: Add 40 μL of trypsin buffer (2 μg trypsin in 40 μL of 100 mM NH4HCO3)
collision energy: the normalized collision energy is 27 eV
fragmentation method: the MS2 activation type is HCD
instrument: connected to the Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
labeling: The samples were analyzed using the Easy-nLC nanoflow HPLC system connected to the Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
precursor tolerance: The search was set at a precursor mass window of 6 ppm
ptm: fixed Carbamidomethyl (C); oxidation of methionine; N-terminal protein acetylation
Carbamidomethyl (C) is selected as fixed modification. The per default oxidation of methionine and N-terminal protein acetylation are used.
reduction reagent: DTT was added to 60 μL of protein solution to give a concentration of 100 mM
reduction concentration: DTT was added to 60 μL of protein solution to give a concentration of 100 mM
